description: Team-authored travel cases: exactly 5 single-turn and 5 multi-turn. They cover behaviors not in eval_travel_base: cancelled departures, bus/train modes, change-date policy, web hotel search, updated guest counts, a genuine confirmation turn, cancelling at the confirmation step and privacy-safe web search.
